Subject: Request: Latest penetration test report + secure delivery options for Hosted API

Hi Mina,

Hope you're well — we're in the middle of our security review for HelioCloud's integration with Redwood's Hosted API and need your help. Could you share the most recent external penetration test report covering the hosted API surface?

We have two primary asks:
- The latest report (redacted is fine) and any summary of open/high findings and remediation timelines.
- How you prefer to exchange this evidence securely (SFTP, encrypted S3 presigned link, secure evidence portal, or other). We need to ingest into our vendor risk platform and provide a copy to our InfoSec lead.

Background: our procurement security team wants to complete an intake by next Thursday (2026-12-10). If there's a short summary page or a one-paragraph current-risk statement you can include, that would help speed review.

Thanks —
Ellen Park
Vendor Risk Manager, HelioCloud
ellen.park@heliocloud.com

Hi Ellen — thanks for the note and the timeline.

We can share the most recent external penetration test (Nov 2026) with standard redactions for customer data. Quick points:
- Report scope: hosted API endpoints, authentication, token handling, admin console (internal) and surrounding infra; excludes dedicated/private deployments.
- Current status: 3 medium observations closed, 1 high remediated and validated, 2 low pending scheduling (ETA 2027-01-15). I can include a one-paragraph risk summary.

For transfer options we support:
1) Secure evidence portal (recommended) — single-use link, audit log, and download expiration.
2) Encrypted S3 presigned URL — password-protected PDF + MFA confirmation.
3) SFTP pull (rare) — require scheduled window and host key exchange.

If you confirm preference, I will coordinate delivery and take care of redaction. Do you need a SOC 2 mapping sheet or the CSV of findings?

Best,
Mina Haddad
Security Programs Manager, Redwood Inference
